Privacy Policy - Moonlight Hostel & PG

At Moonlight Hostel & PG, accessible from https://moonlighthostels.com, we prioritize the privacy and security of our student residents and website visitors. This privacy policy document outlines the types of personal data we collect, how we store it, and the security measures we employ.

Information We Collect

When you apply for a room booking or contact us, we collect personal details including your name, email address, phone number, physical address, and college details (such as D.Y. Patil University). We also collect parent or guardian contact information for emergency purposes and billing/payment transaction details.

How We Use Your Data

Your information is used strictly to manage hostel admissions, verify identity via biometric access systems, maintain on-site security, and coordinate dining and housekeeping schedules. We also use your contact details to send billing statements, booking confirmations, and urgent safety announcements.

Data Security & Access Control

Student records are stored securely on protected databases. Physical entry to the hostel is controlled via biometric fingerprint scanners, and access logs are monitored locally by our resident warden. CCTV camera feeds are kept local and are never shared or uploaded online.

Third-Party Disclosure & Consent

We do not sell, trade, or share your personally identifiable information with outside parties, except for trusted web hosting and email services necessary to operate our website. By using our website, you consent to our privacy policy guidelines.
